checks.notes: The metric inventory is the exact comparison contract and intentionally excludes source line/location fields.
checks.rule: Produce one bounded, exact and location-independent contract row for every persistent artifact; zero census, dynamic blind spots and overflow are unmeasured.
checks.title: Persistent-artifact census

checks.rule: Every persistent artifact has exactly one authoritative classification, owner, restore behavior and reset behavior
checks.title: Persistent-artifact classification

checks.rule: Declared classification and actual backup/restore use must not contradict each other
checks.title: Storage classification/use consistency

checks.rule: Device-local control evidence must never be restorable
checks.title: Device-local evidence restore boundary

checks.notes: The deterministic probe validates explicit native SQL write columns against declared schemas and does not infer defects from dynamic object access.
checks.rule: Report only statically definite persisted-field mismatches; dynamic JavaScript object shapes are not guessed
checks.title: Definite persisted-field read/write mismatch

checks.rule: A module using persistent or device storage must enter through the manifest-bound shared storage gateway
checks.title: Declared storage/device gateway enforcement
